name: demo
description: A live example in a box the reader can drag narrower and wider, with a label naming the width stop it is at, and the code beneath it.

attributes.name: data-height
attributes.description: The preview box's height. A frame inside cannot size to its content, so this is where that is set.

attributes.name: data-width
attributes.description: The preview box's starting width, before the reader drags it. Full width when absent.

children.description: A title for the demo, above the box.
The resizable box. Holds an iframe with the example in srcdoc, or the example's markup directly on a page that already loads Yeti. Carries tabindex="0" because it scrolls.
The framed example, loading yeti.css alone so the host page's styles never reach it. Needs a title.
The code, collapsed: a summary and a pre.

markers.name: data-preview
markers.description: Marks the resizable box. Direct markup taller than the box scrolls, so it carries tabindex="0" to stay reachable from the keyboard.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-height-md
tokens.description: Box height at data-height="md" and by default. The sm, lg, and xl stops are read through the shared height mapping in layouts/attributes.css, not by this file.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-radius
tokens.description: The box's corner, the summary's, and the stop label's.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-label
tokens.description: Surface of the stop label, and of the summary.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: Mixed into the summary's surface for the hover tint.

tokens.name: --yeti-width-xs
tokens.description: The narrowest the box can be dragged.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Clearance direct markup keeps from the box's resize grip, and space around the summary and above the code; also the stop label's offset from the box's corner and its inline padding.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-sm
tokens.description: Text size of the caption, the summary, and the stop label.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text-muted
tokens.description: The caption's colour, and the stop label's.

tokens.name: --yeti-font-mono
tokens.description: The stop label's typeface, so it reads as a readout, not prose.

tokens.name: --yeti-leading-md
tokens.description: The stop label's line height, so the pill is a touch taller than its text.

keyboard.action: On the summary, opens or closes the code.

a11y.notes: Give the iframe a title. Give the preview box tabindex="0": direct markup taller than the box scrolls, and a scrollable region must be reachable from the keyboard. The resize handle is the browser's and works with a mouse or trackpad; a keyboard or touch reader sees the demo at its starting width and has the code, so a demo must never be the only place the markup appears. The stop label is generated content and is not announced; it is a visual aid to the drag.
